result.topic_en: The page concludes a statement that every function of a function field congruent to zero modulo the system of all entire rational functions of the field is an entire algebraic function of them, and begins a proof that xy, xt, yz, zt form the full system of entire rational solutions of the partial differential equation x f_x − y f_y + z f_z − t f_t = 0.
